title: CRaFT: Circuit-Guided Refusal Feature Selection via Cross-Layer Transcoders
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability and model steering to understand and bypass the refusal mechanisms in LLMs. While it utilizes safety benchmarks like HarmBench and AdvBench to measure success in jailbreaking, it primarily addresses the technical aspect of feature selection within the model's architecture rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical reasoning systems themselves.
